name: apple-foundation-models
title: Apple Foundation Models
description: Ask, chat, rewrite text and describe images with Apple's on-device model through the fm command line tool in macOS 27.
author: shanto462

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Ask the on-device model a question and see the answer as it is written.

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Chat
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Chat with the on-device model. Conversations are saved on this Mac.

commands.name: summarize-selected-text
commands.title: Summarize Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Summarize the selected text, or the text on the clipboard when nothing is selected.

commands.name: rewrite-selected-text
commands.title: Rewrite Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text (or the clipboard) in a professional, friendly, concise or simple tone.

commands.name: proofread-selected-text
commands.title: Proofread Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in the selected text, or the text on the clipboard.

commands.name: translate-selected-text
commands.title: Translate Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Translate the selected text, or the text on the clipboard, into another language.

commands.name: explain-selected-text
commands.title: Explain Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Explain the selected text, or the text on the clipboard, in simple words.

commands.name: describe-image
commands.title: Describe Image
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Ask about an image selected in Finder, copied to the clipboard, or picked from a file. It can also read text and barcodes.

commands.name: check-setup
commands.title: Check Setup
commands.subtitle: Apple Foundation Models
commands.description: Check that macOS 27, the fm license, Apple Intelligence and the on-device model are ready.

preferences.name: chatInstructions
preferences.title: Chat Instructions
preferences.description: Instructions for new chats and for Ask. Each chat keeps the instructions it was created with.
preferences.default: You are a helpful assistant running on this Mac. Answer clearly and briefly. Use Markdown when it helps.

preferences.name: translateTo
preferences.title: Translate To
preferences.description: Default language for Translate Selected Text.

preferences.name: useClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Use the clipboard when nothing is selected
preferences.description: The text commands use the text on the clipboard when no text is selected.

preferences.name: permissiveGuardrails
preferences.title: Text Tools
preferences.label: Fewer refusals when transforming text
preferences.description: Use the permissive-content-transformations guardrail level for Summarize, Rewrite, Proofread, Translate and Explain. Apple made this level for working on text you provide.
